groups.title: NCNICC-1:2025 controls with no ECC-2:2024 equivalent

controls.title: Subscribe to a brand protection service that protects the entity's identity from

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Subscribe to a brand protection service that protects the entity's identity from impersonation (e.g., monitoring for brand and domain spoofing and fraudulent lookalike-domain registration).

parts.name: guidance
parts.prose: Entity has active brand/domain protection subscription; evidence of monitoring alerts reviewed.

parts.name: assessment-method
parts.prose: Upload proof of active subscription to a brand/domain protection monitoring service; service must cover domain spoofing detection and lookalike domain registration alerts.

parts.name: remediation
parts.prose: Subscribe to an NCA-recognized brand monitoring service; configure alerts for lookalike domains and impersonation indicators; establish a takedown process for identified fraudulent domains.

controls.title: Security of the use of printers, scanners, and imaging devices used to process e

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Security of the use of printers, scanners, and imaging devices used to process entity information (interpretive: device management, access control, and secure-print and data-purge configuration to prevent unauthorised copying, printing, scanning, or transmission of classified information).

parts.name: guidance
parts.prose: All printers, scanners, and imaging devices are inventoried, access-controlled, configured with secure-print and data-purge functions, and audit-logged.

parts.name: assessment-method
parts.prose: Questionnaire review of device inventory, access-control configuration, secure-print settings, data-purge functions, and audit logging; evidence upload of device management policy and configuration records.

parts.name: remediation
parts.prose: Inventory all printers, scanners, and imaging devices; implement access controls and audit logging; configure secure-print and automatic data-purge; integrate into the asset management (2-1) process; attest compliance.

controls.title: Subscribe to an NCA-licensed managed security service center for cybersecurity m

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Subscribe to an NCA-licensed managed security service center for cybersecurity monitoring and operations.

parts.name: guidance
parts.prose: Entity has active subscription to an NCA-licensed SOC; subscription covers the minimum monitoring scope required by NCNICC 2-12.

parts.name: assessment-method
parts.prose: Upload proof of active subscription to an NCA-licensed Security Operations Center (SOC) managed service provider; license number verified against NCA licensed provider list.

parts.name: remediation
parts.prose: Contract with an NCA-licensed managed SOC provider; verify NCA licensing status before contracting; ensure SLA covers 24/7 monitoring, alert escalation, and incident notification within NCA-defined timeframes.
